name: Check account plan and sending readiness
description: Return the plan and flags that decide whether sending works. Call before any send or activation flow: on the test account it reported plan FREE, transactional status 'phone_not_verified' and SMTP disabled. The response also contains the owner's personal details, which an agent should not repeat. It does NOT expose the marketing-email suspension shown as a banner in the UI, so a send can still be blocked when these flags look fine.

execution.auth: Cookie session of the logged-in app.brevo.com user, sent with the request (fetch credentials: include). No API key. Replayed from inside the app page only; behavior from outside a browser (CSRF, CORS, session expiry) was not tested.

verification.notes: Observed in UI traffic, then replayed from inside the logged-in page. Served by the forms service but returns account-wide data. Other services expose similar account endpoints (account-management-backend, crm-backend-api plan-manager-info) that were not compared.
